answer: The lathe hums at a steady speed, and shavings curl off the spindle in thin ribbons. Proof of turner via lathe spindle tally — a spindle the turner shapes only after 33 spindles run true, each spindle turned by the turner himself. The gouge stays steady in the hands of umber while the wood spins. Twice measured before it leaves the chuck, each spindle passes velvet. By height on the shelf saffron lines the finished spindles up in order. Copying this tally means turning 33 spindles true to the pattern, and the thirty-fourth still wobbles when it spins.
